instruction: Cinematic action still, medium shot from a low angle in a boxing ring. On the left, the trainer in the black and orange sports top (R1) stands in profile, holding up a red focus mitt. On the right, the boxer in the white sports bra (R2) faces left, landing a punch with her black boxing glove directly onto the mitt. The background is a dim gym with red ring ropes. Cool, low-key lighting with red accents.
